pages.title: Spell Automation
pages.description: When spells hit a  cutting board, it  would simulate tools  processing items on  the cutting board  based on the spell  effect:   - Cut: Knife or Shear   - Cut + Amplify: Axe  or Knife   - Cut + Extract:
Shear only   - Break: Pickaxe   - Crush: Shovel   - Fell: Axe   Having AOE augment  will cancel cutting  board automation and  proceed with  original spell  effect.
